issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Observation change request to remove the Observation.category sentence "More fine-grained filtering can be performed using the metadata and/or terminology hierarchy in Observation.code." The resolution said to remove it because it stated a general filtering principle that did not need to appear there.

additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Observation.category comment retains category scheme and value-set granularity language without the removed Observation.code hierarchy-filtering instruction. Related FHIR-11113 clarified category's search/indexing purpose, and later FHIR-50850 added category-vs-code guidance without reinstating the removed sentence. A relevant Zulip discussion also says category inference from Observation.code is not guaranteed.
